title: The Ascetic, the Ghee, and the Honey
logline: A poor ascetic sits under his nearly full jar of ghee and honey, dreams it into a fortune, a house, a wife and a son, gets angry at the imaginary boy, swings a real stick and smashes the real jar over his own head.
moral: Do not build castles on what you have not earned yet: a daydream can cost you the real thing in your hand. (Shown, not written on screen.)
tone: Gentle comedy with a slow fuse. Warm and modest at first, giddier as the dream swells, one beat of real suspense under the jar, a big slapstick burst, then a quiet, rueful ending.

beats.summary: A modest ascetic in a tiny house.
He saves what he does not eat in a clay jar hanging from the ceiling.
Days pass; the jar is almost full.
He sits directly under the jar: the danger is planted.
'If I sold them...': the first thought cloud opens.
Coins become goats; goats multiply; cows and a wide field.
Harvest, a big house, furniture, admiration: a rich man.
The dream grows every moment until it is bigger than the room.
A wife, a clever son, the king's palace.
Real anger at something that never happened.
The swing passes through the picture.
The stick hits the real jar above his head.
The jar and the dream burst together.
Ghee and honey land on his face.
No money, no goats, no field; even the honey is gone.

sets.description: One-room mud hut in cutaway, with sky around it, a door at the left, a window at the right, a ceiling beam with a hook, a mat and a lamp niche; day and dusk palettes. Full dimensions in new_assets.

props.description: hangingJar: clay jar on a rope with fill level, sway, drip, crack and burst states.
Planned prop 'stick' (KD-008): straight brown staff 180 long, 12 thick, slightly knobbed top.
smallBowl x2: 34 wide clay bowls, one with yellow ghee, one with amber honey.
Planned prop 'coinPile' (AN-095): yellow discs with black rims stacked in a mound, n = number of coins.
Flat pictogram props drawn only inside the thought cloud: stall, abacus, moonTick, field, sheaf, sack, loaf, house, furniture, bundle, slate, palace.

scenes.summary: Aftermath. He sits down stunned, dripping. He looks at the shards, then at the stick in his hand. The dream items appear one last time as dotted ghosts and are crossed out: money, goats, field, and finally the honey itself. THE END.

camera.notes: 145.6 {x:380,y:690,zoom:1.9} on the dripping face. 153.7-155.4 tilt down to the shards {x:420,y:820,zoom:1.8}; 157.3-158 over to the stick hand {x:440,y:760,zoom:2.0}. 159.4-160.4 pull out to {x:500,y:600,zoom:1.15}: the bare room, the empty rope, the small man. Hold to the end; THE END card from 168.2.

ending.description: After the last word (167.78) hold the wide shot of the bare room: the ascetic small on his mat in the puddle, a drop on his nose, the empty rope ticking above. 'THE END' pops at 168.2 in the upper right where the dream was and holds to 171.14. No moral text on screen.

subtitles.ar: عاش ناسك في بيت صغير،|وكان يحصل كل يوم على قليل من السمن والعسل.|يأكل ما يحتاج إليه، ويضع الباقي في جرّة من الفخار.|ومع مرور الأيام، امتلأت الجرّة تقريبًا.
subtitles.en: An ascetic lived in a small house|and received a little ghee and honey each day.|He ate what he needed and put the rest in a clay jar.|As the days passed, the jar became almost full.

subtitles.ar: ذات مساء، جلس الناسك تحت الجرّة المعلقة فوق رأسه.|نظر إليها وقال: «كم فيها من السمن والعسل!|لو بعتهما في السوق، لحصلت على مال كثير.»|وبدأ يحسب الأرباح في خياله.
subtitles.en: One evening, the ascetic sat beneath the jar hanging above his head.|He looked at it and said, “There is so much ghee and honey in there!|If I sold them at the market, I would get plenty of money.”|He began calculating imaginary profits.

subtitles.ar: قال في نفسه: «سأشتري بهذا المال بعض الماعز.|وبعد أشهر ستولد لها صغار، ويكبر القطيع.|ثم أبيع بعضه، وأشتري أبقارًا وحقلًا واسعًا.»|ابتسم وهو يتخيل ذلك.
subtitles.en: He thought, “With that money I will buy some goats.|After a few months, they will have young, and the herd will grow.|Then I will sell some and buy cows and a wide field.”|He smiled as he imagined it.

subtitles.ar: ثم قال: «سأزرع الحقل وأجمع المحصول،|ويصبح عندي طعام ومال.|سأبني بيتًا كبيرًا، وأشتري أثاثًا جميلًا، ويعرف الناس أنني رجل غني.»|كان حلمه يكبر كل لحظة.
subtitles.en: Then he said, “I will plant the field and gather the harvest.|I will have food and money.|I will build a big house, buy beautiful furniture, and everyone will know I am a rich man.”|His dream grew with every moment.

subtitles.ar: لم يتوقف خياله عند ذلك.|تخيل أنه تزوج، وأن زوجته أنجبت ولدًا ذكيًا.|قال: «سأعلم ابني القراءة والحساب،|وعندما يكبر سيعمل في قصر الملك، ويفتخر الناس به.»
subtitles.en: His imagination did not stop there.|He pictured himself married, with a clever son.|“I will teach my son reading and arithmetic,” he said.|“When he grows up, he will work in the king’s palace, and people will be proud of him.”

subtitles.ar: ثم تخيل أن ابنه لم يسمع كلامه يومًا.|غضب الناسك من هذا الموقف الذي لم يحدث أصلًا،|وأمسك عصا كانت بجانبه.|قال بصوت مرتفع: «وإذا عصاني، فسأؤدبه بهذه العصا!»
subtitles.en: Then he imagined that one day his son disobeyed him.|The ascetic became angry at something that had never even happened,|and grabbed a stick beside him.|“And if he disobeys me,” he shouted, “I will punish him with this stick!”

subtitles.ar: رفع العصا في الهواء،|وضرب بها كأنه يضرب ابنه الخيالي.|لكن العصا أصابت الجرّة الحقيقية فوق رأسه!|انكسرت الجرّة، وسقط السمن والعسل على وجهه وثيابه.
subtitles.en: He raised the stick|and swung it as though striking his imaginary son.|But the stick hit the real jar above his head!|The jar broke, and the ghee and honey spilled onto his face and clothes.

subtitles.ar: جلس الناسك مذهولًا، والسمن والعسل يقطران من شعره.|نظر إلى قطع الجرّة على الأرض، ثم إلى العصا في يده.|لم يبقَ مال ولا ماعز ولا حقل؛|بل اختفى حتى العسل الذي جمعه.
subtitles.en: The ascetic sat stunned as ghee and honey dripped from his hair.|He looked at the broken pieces on the ground and then at the stick in his hand.|There was no money, no goats, no field;|even the honey he had saved was gone.

new_assets.name: hutRoom
new_assets.description: Poor one-room hut in cutaway for hermits, woodcutters, old women. World 1000 x 1230. Outside: sky (dayCycle) and ground at y 900. Walls x 110..890 (26 thick), flat roof slab y 210..250 with six round beam ends, ceiling y 250, floor y 900. Door opening in the left wall y 620..900 with a leaf that swings (door 0..1). Window in the back wall x 690..830, y 400..540 showing the sky. Ceiling hook at (360, 250). Woven mat x 240..480 on the floor. Lamp niche at (600, 560) with lamp 0..1. Palettes 'day' (ochre wall, blue dots) and 'dusk' (orange wall, red dot shading).
new_assets.implementation: Bake two layers with bake(): back (sky hole for the window is left transparent, wall fill, dots via the style's halftone fill, beams, niche, mat) and front (wall edges, roof slab). Draw dayCycle or sky() first, then back, actors, front. Door leaf is a skewed rectangle scaled in x by the door field. Model it on houseRoom + houseRoof.

new_assets.name: hangingJar
new_assets.description: Clay jar on a rope: body 130 wide x 150 tall (ellipse belly, 60 wide neck, rim ring, two small ear handles), terracotta with red dot shading and a black brush outline. Rope from the hook to the neck, about 180 long. Fields: x, y (hook point), len, swingA (radians), fill 0..1 (shown through an oval cutaway window 70 x 90 on the belly: yellow lower band for ghee, amber top band for honey, level line), drip 0..1 (bead on the rim), glint, crack 0..1 (zigzag crack growing across the belly), broken (0 or 1: only the neck ring on the rope remains), shards (time since the burst).
new_assets.implementation: One function hangingJar(ctx, P). Rotate about the hook by swingA (drive with swing() or a sine). Belly = K ellipse path; cutaway window = clipped rectangle bands. Crack = polyline of 7 seeded points revealed by crack. Shards = 9 fixed polygons cut from the belly outline; after the burst each flies with a seeded velocity, fallY gravity, rebound once on y 896 and rests (pure function of time since the burst).

new_assets.name: goat
new_assets.description: Small side-view goat, about 150 wide x 130 high at s 1. Fields: x, y, s, dir, ph/amp (walk), graze 0..1, fat 0..1, talk, kind ('goat', 'kid' = no horns, big head; 'cow' = body 1.5x wider, black patches, short horns, tuft tail), pal (white, brown, black), plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: Follow the deer drawing's structure (body rounded box, four legs with ph, neck and head) with shorter legs; horns as two tapered arcs, beard a small triangle. Register with acting() in registry.js once approved.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (ascetic, richMan)
new_assets.description: Two more presets for the planned person costume layer. ascetic: small white wrapped turban with a tail (tail angle field for lag), grey-white pointed beard, off-white robe with two blue patches, bare feet. richMan: big yellow turban with red jewel, yellow robe, red sash. Extra optional fields used here: flush 0..1 (planned expression), goo 0..1 (yellow and amber overlay on turban, face sides, beard and shoulders with 4 drip tails), mouth 'tongue'.
new_assets.implementation: Draw the costume over the Library person after the body and before the face (turban replaces the owner's nightcap; beard is a path under the mouth). goo = clipped blobs keyed by the field; drips are small teardrops below it. Keep defaults off so the Thief film is unchanged.

new_assets.name: person kneel / sit
new_assets.description: Planned pose (AN-095, KD-009). sit 0..1: robe folds into a cross-legged base about 150 wide x 60 high (at s 1), torso lowers by about 95; kneel 0..1: torso lowers by about 60 on folded shins. Arms, head and all gestures keep working.
new_assets.implementation: Offset the torso origin by the field and replace the leg drawing with a rounded trapezoid (sit) or folded shin shape (kneel); hand targets stay figure-local.

new_assets.name: person child option
new_assets.description: Planned (KD-011): child on the person figure, small scale with head 1.25x, no facial hair. Here also grows in three steps to adult scale.
new_assets.implementation: Scale parameter plus head factor; moustache flag on at the last step.

new_assets.name: villager
new_assets.description: Planned (KD-005 and others): tunic colour, headwear and height variants of the person; three are used small inside the cloud.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: Planned (6 stories). Here it must also: grow through four box stages (380x300, 600x420, 820x520, 900x600) with a bounce, sprout an extra lobe, change tint (yellow dots to blue dots), flicker to a dashed outline, and pop into dots. Content is clipped to the cloud. Trail of three bubbles from the thinker's head.
new_assets.implementation: thoughtCloud(ctx, {box, open, tint, dashed, pop}, drawInside): outline = union of 9-12 circles along the box's rounded rectangle (seeded radii); fill paper white with light dots; ctx.clip() then drawInside(ctx) in box-local coordinates. pop: replace by 60 seeded dots flying outward for 0.5 s.

new_assets.name: gooSpill
new_assets.description: Thick liquid: a blob (radius 55, yellow with amber swirl) that hangs, stretches and falls; splat crown of 8 drops; steady drips with landing rings; a floor puddle that grows to 220 wide.
new_assets.implementation: Blob = circle stretched in y by fall speed (fallY); splat = seeded drops on short arcs; drips = teardrops on a period list; puddle = flat ellipse with a highlight.

new_assets.name: dreamProps
new_assets.description: A module of flat pictograms, each 80 to 260 units, used inside the cloud: stall (counter and striped awning), abacus (frame with 2 rows of 5 beads), moonTick, field (strip with furrows, w 0..1, crop 0..1, can roll up), sheaf, sack, loaf, house (build 0..1 from 6 blocks, door, roof; storeys 1 or 2; dome; open front), furniture (chair, table, lamp, carpet), bundle, slate (modes letters and sum), palace (arch, dome, 2 flags, crown).
new_assets.implementation: One function per pictogram using K rectangles, arcs and the style's flat fills; all take (ctx, x, y, s, fields). Ghost mode = dashed outline, alpha 0.5, no fill.

new_assets.name: stick, coinPile, smallBowl
new_assets.description: stick (planned KD-008): 180 x 12 staff drawn from grip point and angle. coinPile (planned AN-095): mound of n coins. smallBowl: 34 wide bowl with fill colour and level.
new_assets.implementation: Simple K shapes; the stick takes (x, y, angle) so it follows the hand target.

new_assets.name: dayCycle
new_assets.description: Planned (4 stories): sky running day, dusk, night, dawn with sun and moon on arcs; used outside the hut and in its window for the 'days passed' montage (5 cycles in 3 s) and held at dusk afterwards.
new_assets.implementation: Blend sky presets by phase; sun and moon on a circle about the horizon centre.

new_assets.name: flush
new_assets.description: Planned (KD-008): red Ben-Day dots climbing the face from the neck, with optional steam puffs.
new_assets.implementation: Clipped dot fill over the head shape, height keyed by flush.

owner_questions: The narration says he strikes 'as though striking his imaginary son'; default: the stick only passes through a picture that ripples and re-forms, the boy is never shown hurt, and he stays cheeky (tongue out).

The imagined son is drawn as a small boy during the disobedience (he had just been shown grown up at the palace); default: he is small again, as 'one day his son disobeyed him' reads as a childhood moment.

Added English lettering not in the script: A SMALL HOUSE, GHEE, HONEY, CLAY JAR, ALMOST FULL!, IN HIS HEAD, RICH!, THE PALACE, NO!, NOT REAL, STICK, SWISH!, IMAGINARY SON, CRACK!, REAL JAR, SMASH!, SPLAT!, DRIP, THE JAR, THE END; default: keep all (20 items, mostly labels).

Additions beyond the script inside the dream: a market stall, an abacus, three admiring neighbours, a slate with A B C and 2 + 2 = 4, the son sticking out his tongue; default: keep, they only illustrate narrated ideas.
The moral is not written on screen; default: the crossed-out ghost icons and the last drop carry it, followed by THE END only.

The jar burst needs one short crash sound, but P7 has no pause of 0.6 s; default: a quiet short crash at 139.40 (the boundary before 'broke'), and only a whoosh at 134.0; the CRACK and SPLAT are visual only.
implementation_notes: All times are seconds on the final MP3 (168.14 s); the film is 171.14 s (end_hold 3.0). Use w(p, n) word cues from timing.json; the cue words and times in this file are the script words from timeline.md.

Coordinates are a proposed layout in the 1000 x 1230 world (floor y 900). They are approximate: tune on stills, but keep the vertical stack jar (360, 505) over the seated head (about 350, 715) with a gap near 90 units, and keep the dream son's picture just right of the jar.

Draw order per frame: dayCycle sky, hutRoom back, lamp glow, thoughtCloud (with its clipped contents), hangingJar (with a 6 px paper halo while it overlaps the cloud), ascetic, stick, gooSpill, shards, hutRoom front, labels, then S.finish last.

The jar is the film's metronome: it always sways (swing() or a slow sine, amplitude 0.02 to 0.08 rad). Its amplitude rises at 123.3 (near miss) and 128.5; after the burst the rope stub swings with damped swing().

The thought cloud is one object with keyed box stages: stage 1 at 33.6, stage 2 at 41.65, stage 3 at 62.9, stage 4 in three steps at 80.74, 81.54, 82.70, extra lobe at 85.14, tint change at 105.0, pop at 139.44. Everything inside is drawn in box-local coordinates so it scales with the box.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame for auto-blinks; give the ascetic explicit lid values in the dreamy passages (lid 1 with no blink) and suppress blinks during the held look to camera 138.1-139.3.
Gaze: use look()/gazePlan with targets jar (360, 505), cloud centre, bowls, stick, shards, camera. Use the 0.07 saccade ease when he counts (37.7-40.4).

Stick physics: hold it by PERSON_HANDS.grip and pass the hand's world position and an angle to stick(). Swing 1 (129.12) follows the Fox strike cycle: lift, ease-in whip, damped rebound on the mat. The fatal hit is the upswing of swing 2: contact at 135.56 with the tip at the jar belly (about 400, 540).
Panel-only shake at 135.56 and 144.04 (translate inside the panel clip so the caption panel never moves).
Lettering never covers a face or the jar; place bursts in the wall space right of x 520 or below y 780. No en or em dashes.
Subtitles: 4 chunks per paragraph as marked in 'subtitles'; show each chunk from its first word's start to the next chunk's first word.
Crowds are cheap: goats are one figure repeated in 3 depth rows with seeded phase offsets; never animate them in unison (stagger).
warnings: Four of eight scenes play inside the thought cloud at small scale: figures there are about 150 world units tall; at zoom 1.4 that is over 200 px on screen, but check phone legibility on stills, and keep dream pictograms bold and few on screen at once.
The sit and kneel poses and the costume layer do not exist yet in the Library; this film cannot be staged without them. Build and approve them first (they are shared with AN-095, KD-009, KD-010).
P7 has no pause long enough for effects; the crash at 139.40 sits on a word boundary and must be short (under 0.2 s) and quiet, or dropped if it touches the word.
Stage 4 of the cloud hides the window and lamp; make sure the room still reads as the same hut (keep the mat, floor line and roof beam visible).
The asset list is long (hutRoom, hangingJar, goat, dreamProps, gooSpill plus planned shared assets); dreamProps can be cut down to stall, field, house, slate and palace if time is short.
